$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (form-submission-registration-targets, Task 1, design D1). Adds registrationTarget, an outside system a sibling app registers form submissions in, and registrationRecord, one registration keyed by target, app and submission reference. Both are admin-only for every verb: a target names sources and settings, and a record carries outside urls. Apps reach targets only through SubmissionRegistrationRequestedEvent and the slug-title-kind projection of GET /api/registration-targets.

registrationTarget.title: Registration target
registrationTarget.summary: An outside system a form submission is registered in
registrationTarget.description: Where integriq registers a submission another app hands over (form-submission-registration-targets, design D1): a ZGW case system, the Objects API, a StUF-ZDS case system or a plain JSON endpoint, with its sources, the mapping from the hand-over to the outside shape, the settings of its kind and the apps allowed to use it. Admin-only for every verb: a target names sources and settings.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Stable identifier an app names the target by.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name administrators and the portal picker show.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The integriq source uuids per role: zgw zaken, documenten and optional catalogi; objects-api objects and optional documenten; stuf-zds zkn; json endpoint.

zaken.title: Zaken API
zaken.description: Source uuid of the Zaken API.

documenten.title: Documenten API
documenten.description: Source uuid of the Documenten API.

catalogi.title: Catalogi API
catalogi.description: Source uuid of the Catalogi API.

objects.title: Objects API
objects.description: Source uuid of the Objects API.

zkn.title: StUF-ZKN
zkn.description: Source uuid of the StUF-ZKN service.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Source uuid of the JSON endpoint.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: Uuid or slug of the Mapping from the hand-over to the outside shape.

zgw.title: ZGW settings
zgw.description: zaaktype url, bronorganisatie and verantwoordelijkeOrganisatie RSIN, informatieobjecttype urls for the PDF and the attachments, vertrouwelijkheidaanduiding and optional zaakeigenschappen.

objectsApi.title: Objects API settings
objectsApi.description: objecttype url, objecttypeVersion and an optional informatieobjecttype for files.

stufZds.title: StUF-ZDS settings
stufZds.description: zender and ontvanger (organisatie, applicatie), zaaktypeCode and documenttypeCode.

json.title: JSON settings
json.description: path on the endpoint source and an optional JSON Schema the mapped body must satisfy.

allowedApps.title: Allowed apps
allowedApps.description: The apps that may register submissions at this target.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether apps may use the target.

registrationRecord.title: Registration record
registrationRecord.summary: One submission's registration at one target
registrationRecord.description: What integriq did for one hand-over (form-submission-registration-targets, design D1 and D5): the target, the calling app and the submission reference it is keyed by, its state, the steps already done with their outside urls, and the result. A repeated hand-over answers the stored result or resumes after the last step. Admin-only for every verb.

app.title: App
app.description: The app that handed the submission over.

submissionReference.title: Submission
submissionReference.description: The submission reference the app gave.

state.title: State
state.description: started while running, done once registered, failed after a refusal.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: What was created outside, in order, with its url.

externalReference.title: External reference
externalReference.description: The reference the outside system gave the registration.

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: The last refusal: code, retryable and message.

finishedAt.title: Finished
finishedAt.description: When the registration was done or last failed.
